name: The BVG assets of CHF 500,000 as a lump sum at 65, Zurich
workings: The AHV pension is taxed as in ahv-full-tax-zh; the lump sum separately, as a capital benefit.
Zurich: the rate on 1/20 × 500,000 = 25,000: simple tax 574, a rate of 2.296% (above the 2% minimum); simple 2.296% × 500,000 = 11,480.00; cantonal 10,906.00, communal 13,661.20.
The lump sum costs 35,067.888 once, about 8.7 years of the annuity's extra tax (bvg-annuity-tax-zh).
